dataset_metadata.name: ISS CHeCS Pre-Processed Pharmacological Formulary
dataset_metadata.source: NASA Space Medicine RAG Corpus (ISS Crew Health Care System / Medical Checklist)
dataset_metadata.description: Project medication and pack catalog. Do not treat medication identity, dosage, pack assignment, indication, or lockout text as verified NASA clinical guidance.

subpacks.OMP: Oral Medication Pack (prescription oral antimicrobials, antiemetics, cardiovascular)
subpacks.TIMP: Topical & Injectable Medication Pack (IV/IM antibiotics, opioids, topical antifungals)
subpacks.EMTP: Emergency Medical Treatment Pack (ACLS, anaphylaxis, anticoagulation, reversal agents)

medications.name: Acetaminophen
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Preferred over NSAIDs in dehydration, renal calculi history, or radiation thrombocytopenia.
medications.search_text: Acetaminophen Analgesic Antipyretic CMP 325-650 mg PO headache fever pain. Lockout: hepatic injury, elevated AST/ALT. Safe alternative when NSAIDs are locked out due to renal stones or thrombocytopenia.

medications.name: Aspirin
medications.dose_route: 81 mg PO (antiplatelet) or 325 mg PO (acute ACS/mild pain)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Critical in EMTP for Level V cardiac events; strictly locked out if C2M2 shows radiation-induced thrombocytopenia.
medications.search_text: Aspirin NSAID Antiplatelet CMP EMTP 81 mg 325 mg PO ACS chest pain vascular mild pain. Lockout: radiation thrombocytopenia, GI bleeding, active hemorrhage.

medications.name: Ibuprofen
medications.dose_route: 400 mg PO q6h PRN with food/hydration
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Microgravity hypercalciuria elevates baseline renal stone risk; verify hydration and renal stone history before administration.
medications.search_text: Ibuprofen NSAID CMP 400 mg PO musculoskeletal EVA strain ARED soreness inflammation. Lockout: history of renal calculi kidney stones, dehydration, elevated creatinine, GI bleeding.

medications.name: Hydrocodone/Acetaminophen
lockouts: Hypercapnia / elevated ppCO2 (>3.0 mmHg or symptomatic CO2 toxicity)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Opioids depress central respiratory drive and worsen hypercapnia in closed-loop spacecraft atmospheres. Monitor ETCO2 via Tempus Pro.
medications.search_text: Hydrocodone APAP Acetaminophen Opioid OMP 5/325 mg PO moderate severe trauma pain. Lockout: hypercapnia, elevated ppCO2, respiratory depression, hepatic injury, active EVA.

medications.name: Hydromorphone
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Reduced and erratic IM bioavailability in microgravity due to cephalad fluid shift and muscle atrophy; prefer IV route via ISP. Keep Naloxone ready.
medications.search_text: Hydromorphone Opioid TIMP 1-2 mg IV IM severe trauma burns surgical pain. Lockout: severe hypercapnia, elevated ppCO2, hypotension. Reduced IM bioavailability in microgravity, prefer IV.

medications.name: Ketorolac
indications: Severe acute musculoskeletal/traumatic pain without bleeding
lockouts: Transient renal impairment / elevated creatinine (check i-STAT Chem8+)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: First-line non-opioid for severe renal colic in flight, but requires i-STAT Chem8+ creatinine check and aggressive IV/oral hydration.
medications.search_text: Ketorolac NSAID TIMP 15-30 mg IV IM renal colic kidney stone severe acute pain. Lockout: transient renal impairment, monitor creatinine on i-STAT Chem8+, active bleeding.

medications.name: Amoxicillin/Clavulanate
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Known API degradation and tablet discoloration under prolonged spaceflight storage/radiation; inspect blister pack before dosing.
medications.search_text: Amoxicillin Clavulanate Augmentin Antibiotic Beta-lactam OMP 875/125 mg PO dental infection sinusitis respiratory. Note: API degradation discoloration in spaceflight storage. Lockout: penicillin allergy.

medications.name: Azithromycin
medications.dose_route: 500 mg PO Day 1, then 250-500 mg PO q24h
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Long-duration microgravity induces cardiac remodeling and QTc prolongation; verify baseline/current ECG on Tempus Pro before administering.
medications.search_text: Azithromycin Antibiotic Macrolide OMP 500 mg PO respiratory pneumonia soft tissue. Lockout: QTc prolongation, requires Tempus Pro ECG clearance.

medications.name: Ceftriaxone
lockouts: Concurrent calcium-containing IV solutions in same line
medications.spaceflight_constraints: IV priority over erratic IM absorption in microgravity. Core agent for Level V serious infections.
medications.search_text: Ceftriaxone Antibiotic Cephalosporin TIMP 1-2 g IV IM sepsis pneumonia appendicitis pyelonephritis. Note: IV priority over erratic IM in microgravity.

medications.name: Ertapenem
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Primary broad-spectrum single-agent parenteral therapy for autonomous non-operative appendicitis / Level V surgical prophylaxis.
medications.search_text: Ertapenem Antibiotic Carbapenem TIMP 1 g IV IM intra-abdominal sepsis Level V surgical prophylaxis appendicitis.

medications.name: Doxycycline
medications.dose_route: 100 mg PO q12h with full glass of water, remain upright
lockouts: Esophageal ulceration risk if lying flat (Note: in microgravity, flush well with water)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Photosensitivity risk during high UV/radiation; ensure adequate water bolus in microgravity to prevent pill esophagitis.
medications.search_text: Doxycycline Antibiotic Tetracycline OMP 100 mg PO skin MRSA broad-spectrum. Lockout: photosensitivity in high UV radiation; flush with water in microgravity.

medications.name: Levofloxacin
lockouts: High EVA / ARED musculoskeletal loading (Achilles tendon rupture risk)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Microgravity tendon/muscle deconditioning plus EVA/ARED mechanical stress increases Achilles tendon rupture risk. Restrict heavy EVA/ARED.
medications.search_text: Levofloxacin Antibiotic Fluoroquinolone OMP 500 mg PO severe UTI pneumonia. Lockout: Achilles tendon rupture with EVA stress or ARED, QTc prolongation.

medications.name: Nitrofurantoin
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Ineffective if elevated GFR or altered renal clearance in early spaceflight; monitor response and escalate to fluoroquinolone/ceftriaxone if fever develops.
medications.search_text: Nitrofurantoin Antibiotic OMP 100 mg PO uncomplicated cystitis UTI. Note: ineffective if elevated GFR or altered renal clearance; not for pyelonephritis.

medications.name: Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole
lockouts: Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) / BFO dose risk (bone marrow suppression)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Strictly locked out during solar particle events or ARS due to additive bone marrow suppression risk.
medications.search_text: Trimethoprim SMX Bactrim Antibiotic OMP 800/160 mg PO skin prostatitis UTI. Lockout: bone marrow suppression, radiation BFO risk, hyperkalemia.

medications.name: Fluconazole
medications.dose_route: 150 mg PO single dose or q24h
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Monitor hepatic transaminases (AST/ALT) if prolonged therapy; check Tempus Pro ECG for QTc.
medications.search_text: Fluconazole Antifungal OMP 150 mg PO candidiasis dermatitis. Lockout: hepatotoxicity, monitor AST/ALT, QTc prolongation.

medications.name: Clotrimazole
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Topical emulsions undergo phase separation after >880 days in orbit; inspect cream consistency before application.
medications.search_text: Clotrimazole Antifungal TIMP 1% Cream Topical dermatitis tinea. Note: phase separation >880 days in spaceflight.

medications.name: Valacyclovir
medications.dose_route: 1 g PO TID x 7 days (zoster) or 500 mg-1 g BID
lockouts: Severe renal impairment without dose adjustment (check i-STAT creatinine)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Spaceflight stress and immune dysregulation frequently reactivate latent herpesviruses (VZV, HSV, EBV). Ensure high hydration.
medications.search_text: Valacyclovir Antiviral OMP 1 g PO herpes zoster shingles HSV reactivation immune dysregulation.

medications.name: Promethazine
lockouts: Tasks requiring cognitive alertness / EVA / robotics
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Causes severe cognitive sedation and motor impairment; IM absorption is erratic in microgravity. Prefer Ondansetron ODT if alertness is required.
medications.search_text: Promethazine Antihistamine Antiemetic OMP TIMP 25-50 mg PO IM IV Space Motion Sickness SMS. Lockout: severe cognitive sedation, IM erratic bioavailability.

medications.name: Ondansetron
medications.dose_route: 4-8 mg ODT (orally disintegrating tablet) q8h PRN
indications: Nausea and vomiting (SMS, gastroenteritis, ARS prodrome, medication-induced)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Preferred first-line antiemetic over Promethazine when crew alertness is needed; ODT dissolves without water in microgravity.
medications.search_text: Ondansetron Antiemetic OMP 4-8 mg ODT nausea vomiting. Preferred over promethazine when alertness needed. Caution: QTc prolongation.

medications.name: Meclizine
indications: Space Adaptation Syndrome (SAS) / Space Motion Sickness
lockouts: Immediate EVA or high-precision robotics (mild-moderate sedation)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Used for vestibular neuro-adaptation symptoms during initial G-transitions.
medications.search_text: Meclizine Antihistamine OMP 25 mg PO Space Adaptation Syndrome SAS vertigo motion sickness.

medications.name: Loperamide
medications.dose_route: 4 mg PO initial, then 2 mg after each loose stool (max 16 mg/day)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Strictly locked out in ARS GI syndrome or bacterial dysentery due to toxic megacolon/perforation risk.
medications.search_text: Loperamide Antidiarrheal CMP 2 mg PO gastroenteritis diarrhea. Lockout: radiation GI syndrome ARS, dysentery, bloody stool, small bowel obstruction SBO.

medications.name: Bisacodyl
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Decreased GI motility in microgravity makes constipation common; rule out acute abdomen/SBO before dosing.
medications.search_text: Bisacodyl Laxative CMP 5 mg PO spaceflight constipation. Lockout: acute abdomen, small bowel obstruction.

medications.name: Fexofenadine
lockouts: Avoid taking with fruit juices (reduces absorption)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Non-sedating; preferred antihistamine for EVA and operational duties.
medications.search_text: Fexofenadine Antihistamine CMP 180 mg PO dust regolith allergy rhinitis. Non-sedating, preferred for EVA.

medications.name: Loratadine
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Non-sedating alternative for cabin allergen/dust exposure.
medications.search_text: Loratadine Antihistamine CMP 10 mg PO allergic rhinitis non-sedating.

medications.name: Diphenhydramine
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Anticholinergic effect worsens microgravity urinary retention; strictly avoid pre-EVA.
medications.search_text: Diphenhydramine Antihistamine OMP TIMP 25-50 mg PO IV IM anaphylaxis allergy. Lockout: pre-EVA sedation, urinary retention.

medications.name: Pseudoephedrine
medications.dose_route: 120 mg PO q12h (extended release) or 30-60 mg q6h
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Sympathomimetic vasoconstriction can elevate BP and IOP; monitor SANS risk and urinary retention.
medications.search_text: Pseudoephedrine Decongestant CMP 120 mg PO cephalad congestion sinus. Lockout: elevated IOP, SANS risk, hypertension, urinary retention.

medications.name: Oxymetazoline
medications.dose_route: 0.05% Intranasal spray 2 sprays per nostril q12h (max 3 days)
lockouts: Use >3 consecutive days (rhinitis medicamentosa / rebound congestion)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Limit duration to <=3 days to avoid rebound congestion in microgravity.
medications.search_text: Oxymetazoline Decongestant CMP 0.05% Intranasal severe nasal congestion. Lockout: limit duration <=3 days rebound risk.

medications.name: Mometasone
medications.dose_route: 50 mcg/spray Intranasal 2 sprays per nostril q24h
lockouts: Active nasal septal ulceration / recent nasal trauma
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Safe for chronic cephalad-shift nasal congestion without systemic sympathomimetic effects.
medications.search_text: Mometasone Corticosteroid CMP 50 mcg Intranasal chronic allergic rhinitis nasal congestion.

medications.name: Epinephrine
medications.dose_route: 0.3 mg IM (anaphylaxis, lateral thigh) or 1 mg IV q3-5min (cardiac arrest ACLS)
lockouts: No absolute contraindication in life-threatening anaphylaxis or cardiac arrest
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Continuous 12-lead ECG and hemodynamic monitoring via Tempus Pro required.
medications.search_text: Epinephrine Alpha Beta Agonist EMTP 0.3 mg IM 1 mg IV anaphylaxis cardiac arrest ACLS. Monitor via Tempus Pro.

medications.name: Albuterol
medications.dose_route: 90 mcg/actuation Inhaled 2 puffs q4-6h PRN (or 4-8 puffs acute)
indications: Toxic inhalation exposure (NH3 ammonia, N2H4 hydrazine, combustion smoke)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Use spacer in microgravity for reliable aerosol delivery.
medications.search_text: Albuterol SABA RSP 90 mcg Inhaled bronchospasm toxic inhalation NH3 N2H4 ammonia hydrazine smoke.

medications.name: Fluticasone/Salmeterol
lockouts: Acute status asthmaticus rescue (use Albuterol instead)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Rinse mouth with water after inhalation in microgravity to prevent oral candidiasis.
medications.search_text: Fluticasone Salmeterol ICS LABA RSP 250/50 mcg Inhaled chronic reactive airway post-fire recovery.

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Hold prior to landing/reentry to prevent severe post-flight orthostatic hypotension.
medications.search_text: Lisinopril ACE Inhibitor OMP 10 mg PO hypertension. Lockout: acute dehydration, hyperkalemia, reentry orthostatic hypotension.

medications.name: Metoprolol
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Strictly avoid or taper before reentry/landing due to blunted baroreceptor compensation and orthostatic collapse.
medications.search_text: Metoprolol Beta Blocker OMP 25-50 mg PO Afib atrial fibrillation tachycardia. Lockout: cardiogenic shock, reentry orthostatic intolerance, bradycardia.

medications.name: Nitroglycerin
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Microgravity plasma volume reduction increases sensitivity to venodilation; check BP before every dose.
medications.search_text: Nitroglycerin Vasodilator EMTP 0.4 mg SL angina MI ACS. Lockout: PDE5 inhibitors, hypotensive states.

medications.name: Apixaban
medications.class: Direct Oral Anticoagulant (DOAC, Factor Xa Inhibitor)
medications.dose_route: 10 mg PO BID x 7 days, then 5 mg PO BID (VTE treatment)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Oral maintenance phase after initial LMWH (Enoxaparin) for spaceflight IJV thrombosis; keep Prothrombin Complex Concentrate ready for reversal.
medications.search_text: Apixaban DOAC EMTP 5 mg PO VTE IJV internal jugular vein thrombosis PE. Lockout: active trauma hemorrhage surgery thrombocytopenia.

medications.name: Enoxaparin
indications: Acute VTE / Internal Jugular Vein (IJV) thrombosis
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Initial parenteral bridge for Grade 3/4 occlusive IJV thrombosis before transitioning to Apixaban. Reversible with Protamine Sulfate.
medications.search_text: Enoxaparin LMWH EMTP 1 mg/kg SQ acute VTE IJV internal jugular vein thrombosis. Reversible with Protamine Sulfate.

medications.name: Clopidogrel
medications.dose_route: 300 mg PO load, then 75 mg PO q24h
indications: Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) dual antiplatelet therapy with Aspirin
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Irreversible platelet inhibition; confirm no surgical intervention or ARS cytopenia before loading.
medications.search_text: Clopidogrel Antiplatelet EMTP 75 mg PO ACS. Lockout: planned emergency surgery, active bleeding.

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.spaceflight_constraints: High-intensity statin stabilization during Level V cardiac event.
medications.search_text: Atorvastatin Statin EMTP 40 mg PO vascular contingency ACS.

medications.name: Protamine Sulfate
medications.dose_route: 1 mg IV per 1 mg Enoxaparin given within 8h (slow IV push)
lockouts: Slow IV infusion required (rapid push causes severe hypotension/anaphylactoid reaction)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Critical safety antidote when anticoagulating IJV thrombosis in isolated exploration missions.
medications.search_text: Protamine Sulfate Heparin Reversal EMTP 1 mg per 1 mg Enoxaparin IV enoxaparin reversal hemorrhage.

medications.name: Prothrombin Complex Concentrate
medications.dose_route: 25-50 units/kg IV (dose varies by weight/bleed severity)
lockouts: Disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) without specialist review
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Mandatory reversal backup when Apixaban is deployed for IJV thrombosis.
medications.search_text: Prothrombin Complex Concentrate PCC Coagulation Factor EMTP IV severe bleeding DOAC Apixaban reversal.

medications.name: Naloxone
lockouts: None in emergency overdose; titrate to restore ventilation without full withdrawal
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Mandatory antidote whenever Hydrocodone or Hydromorphone is administered in closed cabin atmospheres.
medications.search_text: Naloxone Opioid Antagonist EMTP 0.4-2 mg IV IM IN opioid overdose respiratory depression.

medications.name: Flumazenil
medications.dose_route: 0.2 mg IV over 15 sec, repeat up to 1 mg
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Caution for acute withdrawal seizures in isolated missions.
medications.search_text: Flumazenil BZD Benzodiazepine Antagonist EMTP 0.2 mg IV reversal. Caution: withdrawal seizures.

medications.name: Melatonin
medications.dose_route: 0.5-3 mg PO 30-60 min before target sleep period
lockouts: Daytime operational shifts (causes phase-shift misalignment if mistimed)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: First-line chronobiotic on ISS for circadian misalignment; non-impairing on wake.
medications.search_text: Melatonin Hormone CMP 3 mg PO circadian disruption sleep shift.

medications.name: Zolpidem
medications.dose_route: 5 mg PO at bedtime (10 mg max)
indications: Sleep initiation difficulty during critical missions
lockouts: Immediate EVA or cabin alarm response window (<6-8 hours)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Crew must have >=6-8h protected sleep window; impairs emergency alarm response if awoken early.
medications.search_text: Zolpidem Sedative Hypnotic CMP 5 mg PO insomnia sleep. Lockout: immediate EVA or alarm response.

medications.name: Zaleplon
medications.dose_route: 10 mg PO at bedtime or mid-sleep
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Ultra-short half-life (~1h) preferred over Zolpidem when shorter sleep windows (<6h) exist.
medications.search_text: Zaleplon Sedative Hypnotic CMP 10 mg PO sleep maintenance short half-life.

medications.name: Caffeine
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Monitor HR via wearable/Tempus Pro; excessive caffeine worsens microgravity dehydration.
medications.search_text: Caffeine Stimulant CMP 200 mg PO alertness fatigue. Lockout: tachyarrhythmias, severe dehydration.

medications.name: Modafinil
medications.dose_route: 200 mg PO once at start of wake shift
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Deployed for mission-critical cognitive sustenance when sleep deprivation cannot be avoided.
medications.search_text: Modafinil Wakefulness Agent CMP 200 mg PO fatigue shifted schedules alertness.

medications.name: Olopatadine
medications.dose_route: 0.2% Ophthalmic Drops 1 drop affected eye(s) q24h
lockouts: Suspected corneal abrasion or penetrating eye trauma (use fluorescein/slit check first)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Verify intact corneal epithelium before instilling if particulate eye exposure occurred.
medications.search_text: Olopatadine Antihistamine Ophthalmic CMP 0.2% Drops allergic conjunctivitis. Lockout: suspected corneal abrasion.

medications.name: Carboxymethylcellulose
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Decreased blink rate and cabin airflow cause frequent dry eye in spaceflight.
medications.search_text: Carboxymethylcellulose Ophthalmic Lubricant CMP 0.5% Drops dry eye.

medications.name: Mineral Oil / Petrolatum
medications.dose_route: Topical Ophthalmic Ointment ribbon to lower lid at bedtime
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Apply prior to sleep period due to transient visual blurring.
medications.search_text: Mineral Oil Petrolatum Ophthalmic Ointment CMP severe dry eye sleep protection.

medications.name: Bacitracin
medications.dose_route: Ointment Topical BID-TID to minor wounds
lockouts: Deep puncture wounds or systemic cellulitis (requires oral/IV antibiotics)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Cleanse wound thoroughly first; monitor for delayed healing in microgravity.
medications.search_text: Bacitracin Antibiotic Topical CMP Ointment minor abrasions cuts lacerations.

medications.name: Hydrocortisone
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Rule out fungal etiology before applying steroid cream to prevent tinea incognito.
medications.search_text: Hydrocortisone Corticosteroid Topical CMP 1% Cream contact dermatitis rash. Lockout: fungal infections.

medications.name: Benzonatate
lockouts: Chewing or dissolving capsule (oropharyngeal anesthesia -> choking/aspiration risk)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: NEVER chew or puncture capsule; aspiration risk is amplified in microgravity.
medications.search_text: Benzonatate Antitussive OMP 100 mg PO dry cough. Lockout: aspiration risk if chewed, swallow whole.

medications.name: Dextromethorphan
lockouts: Concurrent SSRIs / SNRIs / MAOIs (serotonin syndrome risk)
medications.spaceflight_constraints: Screen crew medication profile for serotonergic agents before dispensing.
medications.search_text: Dextromethorphan Antitussive CMP 15 mg PO upper respiratory cough. Lockout: SSRIs serotonin syndrome.
